{{Otheruses|The Hub}}
'''The Hub''' was the primary [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] of the [[Maw Installation]]. All of the facility's other asteroids were anchored to the Hub. The Hub was the location of the primary offices and laboratories, along with the main [[Computer/Legends|computer]] core. Other facilities, including the living quarters, dining areas and recreational areas were also located within the Hub. The docking bay on the Hub was capable of accommodating two [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] at a time. While the Hub was armed with weapon emplacements, they were not capable of fully defending the facility. The four [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] assigned to [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] were intended to fulfill that purpose. The Hub connected to the five lab modules&mdash;[[Lab Module A|A]], [[Lab Module B|B]], [[Lab Module C|C]], [[Lab Module D|D]], and [[Lab Module E|E]]&mdash;and the [[Imperial Garrison (Maw Installation)|Imperial Garrison]].
